newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil petrochemical complex accord to be signed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil petrochemical complex accord to be signed.

text.p: Brazilian state oil giant Petrobras is due to sign a $4.8 billion investment agreement today to build a petrochemical complex in Sao Paulo state, a company spokesman said.
Petrobras will form a consortium with private sector oil companies OPP Petroquimica of the Odebrecht group and Elekeiroz of the Itausa group to build the complex in Paulinia, the spokesman said.

Petrobras is to invest $2.8 billion over the next four years while the two private companies will invest more than $2 billion in the project which is expected to generate around 67,000 direct and indirect jobs.
President Fernando Henrique Cardoso, Mining and Energy Minister Raimundo Brito and Sao Paulo Governor Mario Covas will attend the signing of the investment accord in Sao Paulo.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
